text_simplified: One of the greatest gifts a parent can give a child is good *adab* (manners) — a gift that stays with them for life. The Prophet ﷺ told us that kindness to daughters is a shield from the Fire: «Whoever is tested with any of these daughters, they will be a shield for him from the Fire» (Sahih al-Bukhari 1418).

Arabic «الوالد» is father; English broadens to 'parent'.
